heuristics.name: collocation/plausibility
heuristics.description: pick the option that most naturally fits a generic sentence context implied by the option set (e.g. frayed rope, hushed library, camouflaged animal)

heuristics.name: two-blank coherence/contrast
heuristics.description: for paired options, pick the pair whose relation is most test-like (contrast or tight agreement)

heuristics.name: sophisticated-vocab preference
heuristics.description: tie-break toward the more advanced/ISEE-flavored word

notes: Most picks are guesses; no option certainly rejectable without the stem.
